bank_plan.formula: (lesson_check_items + module_check_items) x 2 alternates + forms x form_length
bank_plan.eighty_twenty_note: 80% instruction / 20% assessment honoured at course level (I+A=T); bank serves lesson checks, module checks, 3 practice forms and a protected final.
bank_plan.size_band_note: Planning range per assessment standard (200-600 skills; 600-1500+ large certification). This is a planning guide, not proof of quality.

mcq_limitation_note: Official test assesses writing and speaking; MCQ/MR cannot assess productive skills. Mastemy teaches all four skills by video and model-answer analysis but scores only receptive and knowledge items.

items.stem: In Speaking Part 2, the candidate has one minute to prepare and must speak for up to two minutes. What is the best use of the preparation minute?

options.text: Note key points and a logical order to cover the cue-card prompts
options.rationale: Correct: brief structured notes support a coherent long turn.

options.text: Write a full word-for-word script to read aloud
options.rationale: Reading a script harms fluency and natural coherence and is not allowed.
An off-topic memorised answer fails task relevance.

options.text: Do nothing and improvise with no plan
options.rationale: No planning risks a disorganised, short turn.

items.explanation: Brief, ordered notes help structure the long turn without scripting.
items.provenance: AI-drafted original item, not from any proprietary, leaked or paid exam source

items.stem: Which behaviour most improves the 'Fluency and Coherence' band?

options.text: Speaking at a natural pace with logical linking and minimal breakdown
options.rationale: Correct: natural flow and coherent linking define this criterion.
Speed is not fluency; it can reduce clarity and coherence.

options.text: Pausing frequently to search for rare words

items.explanation: Fluency and coherence reward natural pace and logical connection, not raw speed.

items.stem: Which TWO improve 'Lexical Resource' in Speaking?

options.rationale: Correct: precise collocation shows lexical range and control.

options.text: Paraphrasing when the exact word is unavailable
options.rationale: Correct: effective paraphrase is explicitly rewarded.

options.text: Inserting rare idioms regardless of fit
options.rationale: Misused idioms reduce accuracy and clarity.

options.text: Repeating the same basic words throughout
Spelling words aloud to show vocabulary
options.rationale: Spelling is irrelevant to spoken lexical resource.

items.explanation: Lexical resource rewards precise collocation and effective paraphrase.
